site.name: Moreco
site.tagline: Bioavailable silicon for plants, animals and people
site.description: Moreco produces and distributes a patented, biologically active and fully absorbable form of silicon (OSA) for agriculture, livestock and human health, alongside ecological disinfection with hydrogen peroxide.

introText: For more than 23 years we have supported agriculture across Europe, Asia and the United States, and since 2014 in Morocco.

Moreco's solutions are chosen with the greatest care, grounded in the science of biologically active silicon. They rank among the leaders of their segment, which guarantees our customers consistent quality and safe use.

Since our founding we have worked to bring growers innovative answers to their own specific problems. Our technologies improve nutrient uptake and strengthen plants from within against disease, pests and climate change. By securing a harvest that is abundant yet healthy, with optimal nutritional value, we help growers position their own brand at the very top of the market. That philosophy still guides everything we do, every day.
home.rdiText: Nineteen trial campaigns run across Morocco, from Midelt to Larache: apples, strawberries, tomatoes, citrus, wheat, olives. Every treated plot is compared with its own control, plant by plant.

agri.name: Agri / Horticulture
agri.blurb: A unique, fully absorbable form of orthosilicic acid: higher yield, better taste and more resilient crops. Also available for biological disease control.

humans.name: Humans
humans.blurb: To be younger, healthier and more vital through biologically active silicon. Also combined with maca, L-arginine, hyaluronic acid and collagen.

animals.name: Animals

general.name: Disinfectant

rdi.intro: Silicon is not a promise, it is a measurement. Since 2016 Moreco has run field trials with Moroccan growers — a control plot against a treated plot, on the same farm, the same season, the same variety.
